title: Pretending and Deadpan Distance with Como si
goal: Use *como si* with imperfect and pluperfect subjunctive alongside pretending verbs for deadpan humour

items: I can use *como si* + pluperfect subjunctive for unreal comparisons with an earlier event.
I can combine *como si* with *fingir*, *hacerse el tonto* and *como si nada* in deadpan speech.
I can avoid the indicative and present perfect subjunctive after *como si*.
